items.question: Is it permitted for an individual in the UAE to privately own, possess, breed or trade in dangerous animals?
items.gold: No, it is prohibited for individuals to own, possess, breed or trade in dangerous animals.
items.fact: Private ownership of dangerous animals is prohibited in the UAE.

items.question: What must an individual obtain before owning a dog of an approved breed in the UAE?
items.gold: A licence from the competent authority.
items.fact: Owning approved-breed dogs requires a licence from the competent authority.
